# NS Design System

> The design system behind Namaste Salesforce (namastesalesforce.com), a Salesforce learning publication on Ghost. One accent blue, a navy gray ramp, Figtree, a 10px rem base, light and dark themes via custom properties. 53 plain-CSS SCSS partials compiled to one stylesheet; optional 5 KB runtime.

Hosted at https://salesforce.imswarnil.com/ from the `design-system/` folder of https://github.com/imswarnil/Namaste-Salesforce (GitHub Pages).

## Use it

- Stylesheet: https://salesforce.imswarnil.com/dist/css/screen.min.css
- Runtime (theme toggle, TOC, copy buttons, quiz tally, toast): https://salesforce.imswarnil.com/dist/js/nsds.js
- Theming: `<html data-theme="dark|light">`, or omit to follow the OS.

## Read these first

- [DESIGN.md](https://salesforce.imswarnil.com/DESIGN.md): every token — colors, type scale, shape, elevation, states, layout classes, motion, z-index, icons.
- [design-guidelines.md](https://salesforce.imswarnil.com/design-guidelines.md): accessibility, gestures, content rules, do/don't, quality gates.
- [design-components.md](https://salesforce.imswarnil.com/design-components.md): 42 component specs by workflow.

## Pages

- [Foundations](https://salesforce.imswarnil.com/docs.html): install, architecture, tokens, breakpoints, theming.
- [Components](https://salesforce.imswarnil.com/components.html): live gallery with copy-paste markup.
- [Sections](https://salesforce.imswarnil.com/sections.html): hero, props, split, trail, pricing, FAQ, CTA bands.
- [Full site template](https://salesforce.imswarnil.com/templates/site.html): a single-page learning publication.
- [Course catalogue](https://salesforce.imswarnil.com/templates/courses.html)
- [Course landing](https://salesforce.imswarnil.com/templates/course.html)
- [Lesson player](https://salesforce.imswarnil.com/templates/lesson.html): rail, article, TOC, quiz, prev/next, mobile lesson bar.
- [Training trail](https://salesforce.imswarnil.com/templates/training.html)

## Source layout

- `src/scss/screen.scss` — the manifest; its `@use` order is the cascade.
- `src/scss/0-abstracts` tokens + fonts · `1-base` reset, typography, article · `2-layout` containers, header, footer · `3-components` 27 partials · `4-templates` 17 partials incl. sections and trail · `5-utilities` patterns, helpers.
- `dist/` is committed; `npm run build` regenerates it and CI fails on drift.
